scope: All ten declared CleanupCause variants are accounted for. The examples cover the reviewed Default rule families plus explicitly labeled diagnostic phases. This is a review inventory, not a claim to enumerate every combination of formatting, formulas and Excel behavior.

families.name: Payload and parser boundaries
families.note: Values, formulas, attributes, unchanged coordinates and explicit exclusions.

families.name: Inherited formatting and font layout
families.note: Font witnesses, local masks, fixed-height baselines, merges and centering spans.

families.name: Row representation proofs
families.note: Dense and sparse promotion, gap restoration, dominant-style selection and fallback.

families.name: Tail rows and layout anchors
families.note: Content-free tails, visible masks, conditional scopes, drawing anchors and hidden boundaries.

families.name: Column coalescing
families.note: Compatible tails, font sentinels, visible border boundaries and uncovered gaps.

families.name: Admission and dependency-sensitive cleanup
families.note: Protection extent, conservative hidden admission, shared formulas, scoped object references and deferred re-cleaning.

families.name: Workbook metadata and package identity
families.note: Scoped aliases and calculation-chain maintenance. Existing style/string indices and unrelated members retain their identity.

cleanup_causes.name: PreprocessEmptySelfClosingCells
cleanup_causes.note: The optional preprocessor is not presented as a production Default reduction.

cleanup_causes.name: EmptyCellsWithoutContent
cleanup_causes.note: Empty payloads are classified through their modeled formatting and layout effects.

cleanup_causes.name: EmptyHiddenCells
cleanup_causes.note: Hidden state alone does not imply removable content.

cleanup_causes.name: UnreferencedWhitespaceCells
cleanup_causes.note: Default retains whitespace. Example 44 isolates the internal rewrite after candidate admission.

cleanup_causes.name: UnreferencedHiddenContentCells
cleanup_causes.note: Production admission is the conservative constant-tail rule. Example 45 is an injected-candidate phase test.

cleanup_causes.name: TrailingLayoutOnlyRows
cleanup_causes.note: The empty tail is distinguished from rows that position a later visual anchor.

cleanup_causes.name: EmptyRowAttributeCleanup
cleanup_causes.note: remove_irrelevant_attributes_for_empty_rows returns the original attributes. No attribute-stripping transformation is claimed.

cleanup_causes.name: SheetDataRangeTailPruning
cleanup_causes.note: Range selection and later pruning must agree on the remaining anchors.

cleanup_causes.name: ExtraneousColumnRangeMerge
cleanup_causes.note: Equal-fill and ordinary tail routes have separate eligibility and replacement predicates.

cleanup_causes.name: WorkbookDefinedNameCleanup
cleanup_causes.note: The current alias predicate matches name and scope, without proving equal formula bodies.

other_invariants.name: Execution equivalence
other_invariants.note: Row-aligned work partitioning and thread counts do not authorize different cleanup decisions. hidden_tail_is_independent_of_parallel_row_chunks supplies a production-entry comparison.

other_invariants.name: Output publication
other_invariants.note: Eligibility rejection preserves sources and prior results. Other local fallbacks remain visible in outcome accounting.

other_invariants.name: Package tables
other_invariants.note: The shrinker does not generally compact or renumber shared strings, styles, fonts or binary assets.

other_invariants.name: Future native post-cleanup
other_invariants.note: Excel-assisted height freezing and broader whitespace transactions remain proposed work and are excluded from implemented-rule figures.
